description: This file defines the DeviceGrain class, which is an Orleans grain implementing IDeviceGrain interface, managing device state including serial number and owner.

classes.name: DeviceGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that manages device state, including serial number and owner, with methods to get serial number and set owner.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the device from the grain's state.

methods.name: SetOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner of the device to the specified customer grain and persists the state.
